audit_items.proof_trace: The HasNode() check only verifies parent existence in fork-choice store, not canonical chain ancestry. Fork-choice retains unpruned blocks on competing forks after finalized epoch, allowing data columns descending from non-finalized forks to pass validation despite not being ancestors of the finalized checkpoint.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker gossips data column for block on competing fork (present in fork-choice but not descending from finalized checkpoint). HasNode() returns true, bypassing the finalized ancestry requirement, causing acceptance of data not on canonical chain.
